journeys.name: my own book, not the owner's

steps.sees: Profile opens on the friend's own account: Net worth · Friend, the money strip, the switcher offering Friend and The Day Trader; the league card beside it ranks everyone, as the leaderboard does
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Profile, the app shall open the friend's own account and shall not open, name as theirs, or list the positions of the owner's account.
steps.judge: can this reader tell this is their own money, in ten seconds?

steps.sees: the positions blotter: XLE, the friend's one holding, on its row
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend reads their positions, the app shall show the positions of the friend's own accounts.
steps.judge: can this reader find what they hold?

steps.sees: the positions as cards: XLE, one tap from Trade
steps.ears: WHEN the friend's positions render on a phone, the app shall show each of the friend's own positions as one tappable card.
steps.judge: can this reader find what they hold?

steps.sees: Trade on the friend's account: the trading ladder's rungs point at the friend's desk, the ticket's account picker offers Friend and The Day Trader
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Trade, the app shall put the friend's own account on the ticket and offer only the friend's accounts to trade from.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which account an order would come from?

steps.sees: a link that names the owner's account: Trade says it is showing the friend's own account instead, and the ticket stays on it
steps.ears: IF the invited friend opens Trade on another member's account, THEN the app shall keep the ticket on the friend's own account.
steps.judge: does this reader know whose account an order would come from?

steps.sees: Settings → Account: the friend's own account card; no fleet-wide switch, no list of accounts nobody owns
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Settings, the app shall show only the friend's own accounts and shall not show the fleet controls or the owner's account tools.
steps.judge: can this reader tell these settings change only their own accounts?

steps.sees: the guest-list address falls back to Preferences; the section list has no Guest list entry
steps.ears: IF the invited friend opens the guest list's address, THEN the app shall not show the guest list.
steps.judge: does this reader land somewhere that makes sense?

steps.sees: the league: every account ranked, the owner and the friend among them, each a link into its own page
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens the leaderboard, the app shall rank every member's accounts, the friend's and the owner's alike.
steps.judge: can this reader find where they stand?

steps.sees: the league's fills, newest first: the friend's XLE buy beside the owner's EEM buy and the bots' orders
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Activity, the app shall show the whole league's fills, other members' included.
steps.judge: can this reader tell who did what today?

steps.sees: Activity → the Booked P&L strip above the feed: realized P&L per account across the league, each a link into its page, on screen without a tap (#784 slice 3 took it out of the section switch); offline nothing is booked yet (the frozen fixture has no closes)
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Activity, the app shall show realized P&L for every member's accounts, the friend's and the owner's alike, without paging away from the feed.
steps.judge: can this reader tell where they stand on what has been closed?

steps.sees: Sauron's page: tiles, the blotter with Guidance on each row, 'You can trade only your own accounts.' beside it; no Close, no New trade
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens another member's bot, the app shall show its book read-only, with no control that would write to it.

expect.text: You can trade only your own accounts.

steps.judge: can this reader tell they are looking, not trading?

steps.sees: Playbooks (Heartbeat merged in as its top strip, #5073); offline: 'No decision trail is wired in this deployment.' — so no playbook card renders for anyone here, and these absences read no data, not withheld names
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend reads another member's bot's playbooks, the app shall not name the playbooks it runs.
steps.judge: can this reader tell the bot is alive without learning its playbooks?

steps.sees: Profile on The Day Trader, the bot the friend owns: the switch gains Playbooks · Thesis; Playbooks' top strip says whether the loop is alive (offline: no decision trail is wired)
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Profile on the bot they own, the app shall offer its Playbooks and show whether it is alive.
steps.judge: can this reader tell whether their bot is running?

steps.sees: Thesis on the friend's own bot: its standing call and the markers behind it (on a phone Thesis takes the switch's More slot, #5072)
steps.ears: WHEN the invited friend opens Thesis on the bot they own, the app shall show that bot's standing call.
steps.judge: can this reader tell what their bot believes right now?
